name: around-spaces
note: Grapheme clusters adjacent to spaces: the space boundaries and the clusters on either side must stay independent graphemes. Covers ZWJ families, flags, skin-tone emoji, combining marks, and Indic conjuncts sitting next to space, double space, non-breaking space, and adjacent Latin letters.
